text: Shreya's daughter Anika graduates from nursing school May 14. Shreya said she's already bought the dress and her husband is flying back from Dubai the day before. Their son Emre is driving up that morning with his girlfriend. Anika wants to work in paediatrics and has already had an interview at the children's hospital. Must get a card before the 14th.
pick up dry cleaning thurs, return library books, renew car insurance before 6/30
Emeka called - his son Finn starts at the big school on September 3rd and he's way more nervous than Finn is. Text Emeka that morning, he'll need it.

Bumped into Irina at the bakery. Her mum fell last week and broke her wrist, surgery's on June 3rd. Irina's staying with her for a week after. I should drop round some food when she's back. Irina also said her brother Gintaras is useless with this stuff and hasn't visited once, so she's carrying all of it herself and sounded exhausted.
Gareth and Lola have finally set a date, it's 8/22 at her parents' farm. He said the hen do is the weekend before and Lola's dreading it lol
note to self: dentist moved to Oct 28, 9:15. Bring the old x-rays.

so Pedro was telling me his little girl lost her first tooth yesterday and then the next day she lost another one, so the tooth fairy is apparently going broke. Ha. Anyway he mentioned she's obsessed with dinosaurs at the moment, which is good to know for her birthday in March.
Ali passed his driving test!! Third attempt. Need to send him something, maybe the car air freshener joke.
Thomas Bianchi, new neighbour at 14. Retired engineer, keeps bees, wife is called Sana. Very friendly. Has a greyhound called Biscuit.
Ming's exams start May 5 and run till the 20th. Her dad says she's barely sleeping. Don't forget to message Ming the night before the first one.
Gintaras rang about the barbecue. It's cancelled, his back's gone again. Ask him how the physio goes on Friday.
Fern's son Jamal got into Edinburgh for medicine. She was in tears telling me. Card + something small for Jamal before he leaves on Sept 12th.
Book MOT. Buy printer ink. Cancel the gym membership before the 1st or they'll charge again.
Ibrahim mentioned his sister Kiara is moving to Lisbon in the spring. He's going to help with the van and then fly out a week after to see the new place.

Voice memo: okay so lunch with Alessia and Victor. Alessia is pregnant, due November 9th, they haven't told his parents yet. Victor's starting a new job at the hospital on the 2nd, so it's a lot at once. She said she's fine but tired. Victor wants a decent coffee machine for his birthday, apparently, she was hinting hard. His birthday is like a week after hers which is October 30.
Olivia's grad ceremony was today. Must send her the photos I took tonight.
Spoke to Nikolai briefly, his dad's in hospital again with his heart. They're doing a scan Wednesday and he'll know more afterwards. Call Nikolai Thursday.
Louis is learning Japanese for their trip in April. Takes it very seriously, has a tutor and everything.
Mrs Gupta from the PTA - school play is Dec 4, her twins both have speaking parts. Emre is directing again.

Zhang told me his wife Amara has her citizenship interview on 7/9. She's been studying for months and is still nervous. He's taking the day off to drive her. I'll text her good luck the morning of. Amara's also started volunteering at the food bank on Saturdays and loves it, and their youngest Kiara has a swimming gala on 7/12, three days after.
Sunil's dog Pepper had her op this morning, all went fine. Check on him tomorrow anyway, he was a wreck yesterday.
remember: haircut sat 10am, then farmers market, then pick up the cake for Sunday
Victor and Imogen celebrate their 10th anniversary on June 18. She's planning a surprise trip to Venice and wants me to keep him busy that afternoon so she can pack.
Alina's first day at the new school went well apparently - her mum Irina said she made two friends by lunchtime and came home talking nonstop. Ask Alina about her new friends next time.
Bruno - vegetarian, allergic to cashews. Supports Benfica. Brother Pedro lives in Porto.

long chat with Yusuf after the match. his eldest Emeka (they call him Mek) has his A level results on August 13th and Yusuf is more stressed than the kid. Mek wants to do engineering at Leeds, needs AAB. Yusuf's wife thinks he'll be fine. Yusuf said he'll take him for breakfast that morning before they open the envelope. text Yusuf afterwards to find out how Mek did
Garage called. Car ready Tuesday, about $340.
Kiara mentioned her grandad turns 90 on May 2nd, whole family is doing a lunch the day after. She wants ideas for something he can actually use.
Finn graduated from his apprenticeship!! His dad Gareth was beaming. Congratulate Finn properly when I see him on the 15th.
Saw Dr Singh about the knee. Physio six weeks, review appointment on Nov 20. Book it at reception.

Imogen's having a rough time, her and Louis split last month and she's moved back in with her parents. Didn't want to talk about it much. I need to check in with her next week, maybe take her for dinner.
Shreya - running the Chicago marathon Oct 11th. Training like mad. Her husband Sunil is doing the 10k the day before.
Note: Emre's mum passed away Sunday. Funeral is Friday at 11. Send flowers to the house before then.
pedro moving flat 3/28, needs help carrying stuff that morning. said I'd bring the car
Gintaras Nowak, met at Lola's party. Works in cybersecurity, big into chess and sourdough. Son just started uni in Glasgow.
Victor's twins start reception on Sept 4th. He says his wife is going to cry at the gate and he probably will too. Ask how the first week went.
Ming's brother Zhang has his PhD viva next Thursday. Ming said he's pretending to be calm but isn't. Wish him luck Wed night.
Renew passport this month!! Expires Jan. Photos first.

Talked to Ali at pickup. Her daughter Sana is doing her grade 5 piano exam on March 19. Practising every day, apparently loves it. Ali's husband got a new job in Manchester so they might move in the summer. She's torn because Sana only just settled at school and her best friend Olivia lives two doors down. Ali seemed pretty stressed about the whole thing.
Amara's little one took his first steps last weekend! She sent a video. Reply to it, I forgot.
Lola's book club moved to the 12th. Her sister Fern is hosting this time.
ok so Bruno's wedding is off, they broke up in the summer and he's only just telling people. He seemed alright, keeping busy with the band. Their gig is November 7th at the Crown, I should go.
Anika finishes her probation at the firm on 4/30. If it goes well she gets a permanent contract.
Get passport photos, pay council tax, drop parcel back at post office.
Jamal's mum has her hip replacement on Jan 8 and he's taking two weeks off to look after her. He looked shattered. Ring him the day after the op.
Yusuf says his daughter Olivia got her first job! Junior designer at an agency in Bristol, starts Monday. Send congrats to Olivia.
Gareth Schmidt - leaving drinks Friday 6pm at the Fox. Retiring after 31 years. Collecting for a gift, put in £20.

Irina's son Nikolai (Kolya to everyone) is doing his first marathon in Berlin on September 27th. She's flying out the day before with his girlfriend. He's been training since January. Message Kolya afterwards to see how he did.
Thomas said Sunil's wife had the baby! Little girl, born June 3rd, both doing well. Sunil's on paternity leave until the end of July. Get a card and maybe a babygrow before we see them.
Fern's going to Japan for three weeks in April, then straight on to her cousin's wedding in Seoul the week after she lands back. Wild.
Ibrahim's son is graduating 5/22 from Michigan. Ibrahim and his wife fly out on the 19th and stay a week after. He's super proud, first in the family to go to uni.
Bring the folding chairs to the school fete Saturday. I'm doing the tombola, starts at 1.
Alessia hates surprises, do NOT throw her anything for her 40th. She'd prefer a quiet dinner. Her partner Emre agrees.

Quick catch up with Kiara. She's been anxious about her nephew's operation on the 9th, he's only six. Her sister is staying at the hospital with him. Kiara's going down the next day. Text her that evening to check how it went.
Sana said Ming got the scholarship! So happy for her.

Amara's daughter Lola sits her eleven plus on Sept 14. Amara is a nervous wreck but Lola seems unbothered. Results come out mid October. Her husband Thomas wants to take Lola to the coast the weekend after the exam whatever happens, which is sweet. Don't forget to ask Amara how it went.
car boot sale Sunday - get there by 7. Take the old bike and the lamp.
Louis: has started climbing, goes three nights a week. Wants new climbing shoes, size 43, been hinting about them for ages. Birthday 2/11.

dinner at Pedro and Alina's. Their son Bruno got his black belt last week, they had a little party afterwards. Alina's mum is visiting from Kyiv until the 30th, lovely woman, makes incredible dumplings. Pedro says he's thinking about going part time next year. Alina wants to do a pottery course. I need to send Alina the link to that studio in town.
Victor's brother Emeka is getting married in Lagos on December 12th. Victor's going for two weeks. Asked me to feed the cat while he's gone.
